configuration.query: Which city has the highest total estimated revenue in deals this year?
configuration.rephrase: The query will find out all customer deals where deal date is in this year, then calculate the total estimated revenue of each city, and keep the highest one.
configuration.standardsql: SELECT TOP 1 [cr696_addresscity], SUM([cr696_estimatedrevenue]) AS [totalEstimatedRevenue] FROM [cr696_customerdeal] WHERE [cr696_dealdate] = 'this year' GROUP BY [cr696_addresscity] ORDER BY [totalEstimatedRevenue] DESC
